messages:
Ravi: Pinging the group for quick a11y sanity check on the latest dashboard prototype. Main issues reported by support: screen reader reads the page title twice on navigation and keyboard users can't reach the sort dropdown reliably. Link to prototype: https://proto.redwood/dashboard/v3 June: Quick manual pass: I can repro double announcement. We both set focus to `main` after route change and also update an `aria-live` region with the same message. That causes NVDA/VoiceOver to read twice. I'd remove the live region update for route changes and only set focus once. Sam: Agreed. For route transitions the pattern we want: 1) update document.title, 2) focus the main landmark (main#content). Avoid simultaneous aria-live region updates that repeat the title. If we need an additional announcement (e.g., "New metrics loaded"), use a polite, offscreen status element that updates only on content delta, not on every navigation. A11yBot: automated-scan: issues=6; color-contrast(2), focus-visible(1), duplicate-announcement(1), order(1), aria-roles(1). Report: https://a11y.redwood/1779003333/report.json Ravi: Sort dropdown keyboard issue: when you open the dropdown the focus doesn't land on the first option, forcing two tabs to reach options. Also the dropdown close X is not reachable by keyboard (it has tabindex=-1). June: Checklist for dropdowns: when opened via keyboard (Enter/Space) focus the first option or the menu container with role=menu and roving tabindex for items. Ensure close button is in tab order (or use Escape to close and restore focus to the trigger). Example markup: `
  • Latest
    • ...
` and JS to manage roving focus. Sam: For visual focus, replace subtle shadows with a reliable outline for keyboard. CSS: `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` and ensure `--focus-accent` contrasts with both light/dark surfaces. Also avoid using `box-shadow` alone for focus because some low-power GPUs drop it or it can be hard to see against card borders. QA: Contrast issues flagged: metric delta green `#1DB954` on white is fine, but muted labels `#707070` on white are ~4.0:1. We should bump to `#333333` to reach 7:1 if possible, or at least 4.5:1. Please confirm token name to update. Ravi: We'll update `--text-muted` to `#333333` and `--focus-accent` to `#0055CC`. Also want to add a skip link: `Skip to content` visible on keyboard focus. June: Virtualized list note: when items are removed/inserted keep stable DOM ids (`data-model-id`) and include `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` for assistive tech to give context. Avoid reusing ids for different items as that confuses SR users. Sam: For card headers, use heading elements (h3) with ids and make the card a region: `

Model X

`. That way screen readers announce the card label when focused. A11yBot: reminder: decorative svgs should have `aria-hidden="true"` or empty `alt=""` to avoid noise. QA: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) No duplicate announcements on nav (title only once); 2) All interactive controls keyboard reachable in visual order; 3) Body text >= 4.5:1; 4) Focus visible for keyboard with token `--focus-accent`; 5) Cards have role=region + aria-labelledby; 6) Virtualized lists expose posinset/setsize. I'll add automated checks for these plus a manual NVDA pass. Ravi: Owners: Sam -> dropdown fixes, focus styles, skip link; June -> instructions for route focus vs live regions + sample code; QA -> tests. Target PR by 1779600000 (end of sprint). June: Sample route focus snippet: `document.title = newTitle; const main = document.getElementById('content'); if (main) { main.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); main.focus(); main.removeAttribute('tabindex'); }` — do not call `announceViaLive(newTitle)` after this. Sam: I'll open a WIP branch with the dropdown menu PR and the focus token change. Dropping tokens here: `--text-muted: #333333`, `--focus-accent: #0055CC`. Will include screenshots and voiceover/NVDA notes. QA: I'll run the CI contrast job once the PR lands and schedule a quick pairing test with voiceover. Thanks everyone. Ravi: Thanks team :rocket:
